findings: CONTENT/HONESTY PASS (9/9 hard checks): 62/62 rows complete and uniquely identified; every cited source_id resolves in the 97-record registry; every registry record carries a locator; no content_status=verified row is grounded only in metadata-only evidence; every abstract-read row has at least one abstract/full-text anchor (the documented conservative derivation holds); unresolved is present and populated on all 62 rows with no empty entries; all class tokens are inside the four frozen classes; citation_audit has exactly one row per registry source with resolver_result=resolved, reviewer set, class_mapping inside the frozen classes, and used_by_theorems mirrors ledger usage exactly (0 mismatches, both directions); the five assessed_no_binding sources are cited by no ledger row.

HF-W005-L0-01 (evidence hygiene, blocks accept): ledger/citation_audit.csv stores a discovery query rather than the record locator in the column named exact_locator for 67 of 97 rows (arXiv api/query and INSPIRE ?q= search URLs); 10 of these are sortBy=submittedDate queries whose top result can change as new papers appear. artifacts/literature/L0_L1_ACCEPTANCE.md states 'The L1 exact_locator column carries the primary page/record URL', which the measured data contradicts. Every affected source already carries an exact url/DOI/arXiv id in artifacts/literature/sources/batch-*.jsonl (0/97 registry urls are query-style), so the repair is mechanical: set exact_locator to the registry record url and keep the discovery query in a separate column. This is an evidence-binding defect in the audit layer only; the ledger rows themselves are not affected.

Advisory F-W005-L0-U1: 21 rows carry neither class_ids nor informs_classes (13 of conclusion_type theorem/conditional_theorem among them); they are context rows, and a reader cannot tell which frozen class, if any, they inform.
Advisory F-W005-L0-U2: T-515 and T-528 carry both AF-WCC-VAC-GEN and AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN in one class_ids list; per-statement attribution to a class is not separable from the row.
Advisory F-W005-L0-U3: 13 rows mix metadata-only and abstract-level anchors, so the row-level verification_status does not identify which cited source grounds the statement.
Advisory F-W005-L0-U4: citation_audit.assessment mixes 'assessed: <ids>' lists with prose 'assessed_no_binding: ...' entries in one column (5 prose rows).
Advisory F-W005-L0-U5: entry_kind has no documented controlled vocabulary; 13 observed values, including the singleton 'background' (D-009).

Primary-source spot check (pre-registered plan, 5 samples, one per class plus the sole unverified row): 5/5 locators resolved HTTP 200 and 5/5 titles matched the registry; 2/5 could be scope-verified from the fetched abstract (D-001, D-002); 3/5 were metadata-consistent only (D-003 via a query locator showing a C^{0,1}_loc paper used as a vocabulary anchor; T-101 and D-009, both already labelled provisional/unverified by the ledger). No sampled locator failed to resolve; no hard spot-check failure.

Independence/conflict: worker-005 is not an author of ledger/theorems.jsonl, ledger/citation_audit.csv, or artifacts/literature/sources/*; no other reviewer's L0 verdict file was read before writing this one; only the owner's L0-freeze-reconciliation.json announcement and the artifact's own docs were used as context. Same model family as the ledger author (DeepSeek Flash), so this is one independent instrument, not a vendor-independent verdict.
falsifier: Re-measure the two pins: a ledger or citation-audit sha256 differing from the reviewed hashes, a repaired citation_audit whose exact_locator column now carries the registry record url (which would falsify HF-W005-L0-01 specifically), a sampled locator resolving to a different work, or a different reading of a cited abstract contradicting a row's statement_exact voids or refutes this review.
